title: A Man Called X
paragraphs: An international espionage drama following American agent Ken Thurston as dangerous assignments take him across the world, with Herbert Marshall in the title role for most of the series.

International espionage/adventure series centered on agent Ken Thurston and recurring conman/helper Pegon Zellschmidt. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 112 dated broadcast objects plus three reference tracks.

GRH documents the program through CBS summer replacement (July 10, 1944 to August 28, 1944) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Blue Network / Lockheed (September 9, 1944 to March 3, 1945) on [[org|org.acb290b0843b31ec|Blue Network]], CBS / Frigidaire (April 3, 1947 to September 26, 1948) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and Later NBC run (October 13, 1950 to May 27, 1952) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are [[person|herbert-marshall|Herbert Marshall]] (performer on 69 recordings), Leon Belasco (performer on 65 recordings), J. Richard Kennedy (producer on 31 recordings), Jack Johnstone (director on 30 recordings, performer on 1 recording, and producer on 1 recording), Sidney Marshall (writer on 27 recordings and performer on 1 recording), Felix Mills (composer on 24 recordings and conductor on 24 recordings), and Jack Latham (announcer on 22 recordings and performer on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), and [[org|org.0e05223f9d198710|Nostalgia Broadcasting Corporation]] (syndicated by).
